acme_jane: Hey team — seeing a bunch of production errors for our consumer when using JSON mode. Parser throws a JSONDecodeError. Example response we got:

acme_jane: ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

---
# model debug
model: gpt-4o-structured-v1-q8
---
{"items": [{"id": "123", "value": "ok"}]}
```

acme_jane: Consumer expects raw JSON but the response is wrapped in YAML frontmatter. This started after last week's runtime update. Any ideas?

jessica_support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the original request (headers + body) and a request_id if available? Also which model did you pin?

acme_jane: Request id: req_0b9f2a. We call /v1/generate with body: `{"model":"gpt-4o-structured-v1","input":"...","format":"json"}`. We didn't pin the variant, using default routing.

mike_eng_oncall: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: smart routing fallback kicked in and routed to a quantized variant that accidentally emits YAML frontmatter for debug metadata. That will break strict JSON parsers. Can you share a raw response body (not prettified) and the exact timestamp?

acme_jane: Raw body included above, timestamp 2024-08-12T14:07:09Z.

mike_eng_oncall: Confirmed in logs: at 2024-08-12T14:07:09Z routing chose `gpt-4o-structured-v1-q8` as a fallback. Runtime bug: some quantized variants emit diagnostics as YAML frontmatter before JSON payload. Ops note: fallback is allowed by routing policy `smart` by default.

jessica_support: Immediate mitigations: 1) Pin `model` to the exact non-quantized model_version (add `model_version: gpt-4o-structured-v1`). 2) Disable fallback via `routing.allow_fallback=false` in your request as a short-term workaround. 3) Add tolerant parsing on consumer side if feasible.

lex_runtime: @mike_eng_oncall assigning to eng-runtime. I'll open INC-12345. Repro steps for runtime team:
1) Send a batch of structured requests with routing.policy=smart and `model: gpt-4o-structured-v1`
2) Force capacity shortfall to trigger fallback to `-q8` variant
3) Observe response payload — should have leading YAML frontmatter followed by JSON body

lex_runtime: Example curl to reproduce:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-structured-v1","input":"test","routing":{"policy":"smart"}}'
```

mike_eng_oncall: Quick patch idea: runtime should strip any leading `---
` YAML frontmatter in responses from variants before returning to customers. Long term: ensure postprocessing is consistent across model variants and add unit tests for structured-mode parity.

acme_jane: Appreciate the workaround. Could we get a support escalation / ETA? Our production parser fails on ~5% of requests (those routed to fallback) which is impacting customers.

jessica_support: Creating INC-12345 and marking P1. Eng-runtime to triage. We'll also issue a credit for affected requests under the SLA.

mike_eng_oncall: I'll own the hotfix. Plan: push a narrow runtime change to strip frontmatter and deploy to hosted-inference within 2 hours, then run synthetic test suite. If risky, propose a config toggle to disable textual frontmatter for all structured-variants.

lex_runtime: Action items:
- mike_eng_oncall: hotfix strip frontmatter (2h)
- lex_runtime: add regression test and ensure CI runs with quantized variants (24h)
- jessica_support: coordinate customer comms + credit (1h)

deploy_bot: deploy request queued: runtime/strip-frontmatter -> staged -> canary -> prod

acme_jane: Thanks all. We'll pin model_version for now. Let me know if you need sample logs or more reproducible cases.

jessica_support: Thx — tagging you on INC-12345 and will update when canary passes. :thumbsup:

mike_eng_oncall: Also noting follow-up: product should consider adding a `response_format: json_strict` flag that enforces no extra wrappers from any variant (suggestion for roadmap).

acme_jane: +1 on response_format flag. Our team will keep an eye on canary and revert pin once fixed.

lex_runtime: Closing notes: root cause = smart-routing fallback to quantized variant that prepends YAML frontmatter. Fix = strip frontmatter + add parity tests + consider request-level strict mode.

acme_jane: Verified in staging after workaround — consumer no longer errors. Thanks everyone! :heart:
